cases.name: Virginia “Ginny” Hannon
cases.about:
She was a lunch lady / cook at Bryantville Elementary School. Her nephew Richard Hannon described his aunt as a good woman who enjoyed bingo and ice in her beer. Though she never had children of her own, she loved the little ones she fed each day. Her husband had died in 1977. He said she was social and loved to have a good time and she was always smiling. She hosted parties in her yard for neighborhood children and caried for stray animals. In the days after her death, Rich Hannon said, the cats and dogs continued to show up in her yard, looking for the kind woman with the smile. She also also took care of her father-in-law, who lived two doors down.
